string.name: about_intro_body
string.value: HarmonyPasswordStore is a HarmonyOS implementation of password-store (pass), compatible with the standard GPG-encrypted pass store format. All passwords are stored locally encrypted as .gpg files, private keys are managed via HUKS, and Git sync over SSH and HTTPS is supported.

string.name: about_deps_body
string.value:
• libgit2 — Git repository operations (MPL-2.0)
• pgp / rpgp — OpenPGP encryption (MIT or Apache-2.0)
• russh — SSH protocol (MIT)
• mbedTLS — TLS encrypted channel (Apache-2.0)
• ssh-key — OpenSSH key format (MIT or Apache-2.0)
• See Cargo.toml and CMakeLists.txt for the full dependency list

string.name: about_source_body
string.value:
This project is fully open source; reviews and contributions are welcome:
%s

string.name: privacy_s1_body
string.value: HarmonyPasswordStore is an open-source password manager compatible with the standard pass store format. The app follows the principles of "local first, privacy above all": your password data is always stored encrypted on your local device and is never uploaded to any third-party server.

string.name: privacy_s2_body
string.value: All password entries are stored on the local file system as GPG-encrypted files (.gpg); the encryption keys are yours alone. PGP/SSH private keys are managed by HarmonyOS HUKS (unified key management) and never stored in plain text. Decrypted plaintext exists only in working memory; sensitive caches are cleared automatically when the app goes to the background.

string.name: privacy_s3_body
string.value: For multi-device sync, the built-in Git support can push the password store to your own Git server (GitHub/Gitee/self-hosted). Sync channels support HTTPS (encrypted via mbedTLS) and SSH (encrypted via russh); authentication credentials (token/SSH keys) are stored only locally and never pass through any intermediary server.

string.name: privacy_s4_body
string.value: The app lock supports biometrics only (fingerprint/face): unlocking verifies identity on the device itself, biometric data is managed by the system security module, this app cannot access raw biometric information, and no PIN/passphrase digests are stored. Failed-attempt limits are enforced by the system.

string.name: privacy_s5_body
string.value: After a password is copied to the clipboard, the app automatically clears the clipboard after a configurable time (30 seconds by default) to prevent other apps from reading it.

string.name: privacy_s6_body
string.value: App logs (hilog) never record passwords, keys or decrypted plaintext; they only record operation status and file paths for debugging.

string.name: privacy_s7_body
string.value: This app collects no personally identifiable information (PII), embeds no analytics SDK, embeds no advertising SDK, and uploads no user data.

string.name: privacy_s8_body
string.value:
This app is open source under the GPL-3.0 license; the source code can be reviewed in the GitHub repository:
https://github.com/gmg137/HarmonyPasswordStore
